# FMC Media PC 0.2.8

- Updates install over the existing version, keeping your library, progress and settings. Future in-app upgrades close FMC and restart it after installation.
- Redesigned title pages: cinematic banner, watch availability, episodes, crew/cast, recommendations, media gallery and title information.
- Replaced the overflowing season strip with a compact season selector that works in smaller windows.
- Anime pages include the other seasons from their explicitly matched IMDb series. Demon Slayer now includes all five canonical seasons and specials, with the existing AniList episode mapping preserved.
- AnimeRift (CR2, BBZ, VRV) remains available under Arabic Sources at 1080p/720p.

Media and availability depend on metadata coverage and configured services. Episode season numbering follows the canonical series catalog.
